page.layout: One printed page: the e-rara digitiser's cover sheet. Logo at top right; title block centred; a divider rule; a block of multilingual terms-of-use notices in small type below; Visual Library logo bottom right. No printed text of the book itself.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not part of the book: logo, title block, e-rara access notices and Visual Library logo left out as page furniture. Title data for reference: "De corporis Christi omnipraesentia sive ubiquitate, theologorum quorundam Germanorum sententia in novo ipsorum doctrinae christianae corpore comprehensa, cum eiusdem modesta et christiana ..." [Bèze, Théodore de], [Genève], 1578. Bibliothèque de Genève, Shelf Mark Su 183.
